name: rcore_app
description: Frappe compose template for the hosting docker product (composes an app named rcore)
_comment: Common modules only for now, exactly as telephony.json: the hosting module joins this template once rpanel's hosting module is broken out of the control stack into SDK form - hardware/hosting/frappe is fixtures-only today (the six Hosting Subscription Plan seed records and their Items, no manifest.json), see its README. The Next.js half is composed today: the sdks[] in core/utils/nextjs/composer/hosting.json are the hosting shell (RokctAI/hosting, app_type hosting) - Ray, 2026-09-09: "hosting will just be a seperate frontend for rokctapp, but it points to control site. just hosting focused and filter subscriptions to show only hosting related"; rpanel stays a standalone product (hosting/docs/spec.md), so the shell is a storefront on the control site and nothing more. hosting_sdk is its home SDK (home_sdk: true) beside the three kernel SDKs; NO agent_sdk, whose integrations are unconditional (the agent: true flag at // @rokct-sdk-flags-start flips the shell AI-first) and whose plans query excludes the very plans this shell sells (agent_sdk 1.10.0).

modules.name: gateways
modules._comment: Replaces the retired 'pay' entry (../pay/payments/frappe no longer carries a frappe module or manifest.json): pay's payments/frappe content moved into the gateways and wallet modules, so this template mirrors rcore.json's wallet+gateways pair.
